title: No-reset reachable-state causal learning under hidden three-way logic

parent.parent_ci: focused, G29, full regression Linux/Windows PASS; scientific superiority test NEGATIVE

question: When physical interventions must be reached through the agent's own actions, can a source-blind gradientless learner discover unfamiliar multiway causal rules, retain safe knowledge, and plan actions from new starts?

design.source_path: research/contrib/chatgpt/WSP-61/source.py evaluator-only; not reused WSP59 or WSP60 source family
design.family_A: 6 worlds: four binary state variables, four shuffled action channels, unknown shuffled role indices; action 0 unconditional toggles first role, then conditional toggles form a causal chain of control dependence.
design.family_B: 6 worlds: four binary state variables and shuffled action channels/roles; actions 2 and 3 toggle on XOR parity of three other current bits, adding third-order conditional rules outside WSP60's <=2-parent structure.
design.reset: One fixed initial all-zero sensor state per world. Training can call evaluator step() ONLY for the current reachable state/action. The next observation state becomes the only next legal training state. No state teleport, query reset, oracle shortest path, or hidden world information available during training.
design.cost: Each arm must execute exactly 80 chronological charged actions from initial all-zero. Identical 80-action cap per world; no uncharged scientific evaluation feedback fed into learner. 12 x 80 = 960 observed actions per arm.
design.policy_arms: Causal active action selector: prefer uncovered context, uncertain predicted outcomes and next state novelty when predicted, using only public history. Seed-hashed uniform random action control. Both use identical gradientless learner and initial state; any divergent state trajectories are logged.
design.learner: Infer current state bit width from observed sensor tuple; at most 3 parent input bits per output bit. Keep all consistent partial lookup explanations for every subset of 0..3 parents, abstain whenever *any* remains ungrounded/disagrees at query; direct numerical tables, no oracle channel roles, no prewired source physics, no gradient or tokens.
design.task_generation: 32 deterministic evaluator-only two-to-six-step distinct-state goal tasks/world, selected from source-reachable states and oracle shortest paths. Each task supplies a starting sensor state tuple and an exact target sensor state tuple; no language grounding is claimed. No source shortest-path plan or hidden physics exposed to the agent.
design.test_scoring: 384 identical tasks/arm; max six actions in generated agent plan; goals evaluated by actual source dynamics. Separate 12*64 heldout state-action prediction audit (all states and actions), 100% false-confidence penalty. Evaluate cold-restored planning/prediction parity.
design.controls: Same action-count random policy with same model/planner; active exact observed-state/action lookup with same 80 interventions; evaluator-only oracle to audit reachability/upper bound, never present to learner.
design.dev_protected: SELFTEST seeds only. DEV/PRIMARY explicitly blocked, scientific first use not authorized.

criterion: SELFTEST_SIGNAL if active success >=55% of 384 heldout tasks, active advantage >=10 percentage points over random on exactly matched tasks, zero active confidently wrong physical predictions on 12 x 64 state/action audit, action custody 80 exactly per arm/world, and cold-restore parity. Otherwise SELFTEST_NEGATIVE_OR_INCONCLUSIVE. Zero-wrong constraint cannot be relaxed.
secondary: Source-state coverage and pair-action coverage attained while physically navigating; no-reset enforcement
Chain vs triple-XOR family separate results
Whole-process action count, model selection effort, snapshots including raw evidence, CPU/wall
Exact observation lookup ablation with same active history; source oracle upper bound reported
Cross-platform deterministic source and action ledger SHA256 receipts
limits: This still assumes transparent binary physical sensors and a prior bound of 3 causal parents, so it is not unconstrained representation discovery.
Supplied goals are raw target state vectors, not natural language. Prior WSP59 taught symbol mapping should not be inherited as an untested result here.
Unseen starts provided by evaluator only at final testing, not by a training reset. Test prep oracle selects achievable tasks but supplies no plan to learner.
Not independent natural-world general intelligence or matched strong conventional neural baseline; no scientific superiority claim.
No deployment, merge/promotion, paid API, schedule, runner reconfiguration, controller change or official loop integration.
stop_rules: Frozen seeds/families/budgets/criterion before generator or model implementation/outcome.
Do not tune prior, policy, threshold or goals after seeing SELFTEST outcomes; keep negative.
Infrastructural or harness defects corrected only without changing frozen semantics; otherwise a new prospective experiment.
Require source/PR exact SHA, Linux+Windows focused and mandatory inherited full regression, G29 atlas on candidate.
